Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is German.
Russian(x) ::: x is Russian.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
MemberOfParliament(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Y <- PrussianStateParliament ::: y is the Prussian State Parliament.
Y <- NaziReichstag ::: y is the Nazi Reichstag.

Premises:
HeinrichSchmidt is a German politician.
HeinrichSchmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.

Conclusion:
German(heinrichSchmidt) ∨ Russian(heinrichSchmidt)
